articles.summary: HOLLYWOOD, FL AND MIAMI, FL – HEICO Corporation (NYSE:HEI.A, HEI) today reported that Eric A. Mendelson and Victor H. Mendelson, its Co-Chief Executive Officers and Co-Chairmen, received the Wright Brothers Memorial Award from the Greater Miami Aviation Association (GMAA) at its annual gala dinner on October 10, 2026.
articles.title: HEICO CORPORATION CO-CEOs AND CO-CHAIRMEN RECEIVE WRIGHT BROTHERS MEMORIAL AWARD
